title: rosa stylosa subvar. fastigiata
intro: Rosa stylosa subvar. fastigiata, commonly known as the climbing rose, is a type of flowering plant that is native to China. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa stylosa subvar. fastigiata include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
